title: When Wrong Answers Remain Unsettled: Failure Dynamics in Recurrent Reasoners
abstract: arXiv:2611.28971v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When a recurrent reasoner returns a wrong answer, is its computation finished or merely stopped? We test this on a trained Hierarchical Reasoning Model (HRM; 27M parameters, Sudoku-Extreme) by running the recurrence for one more inference budget and comparing with an unperturbed control. Solved answers persist (0.95 of 512 endpoints). Wrong answers mostly do not: 0.42 of near-miss answers (n=170) and 0.18 of all 512 wrong endpoints keep their answer. Perturbations from 0.05x to 20x the terminal-update scale barely change these rates, so the measurement reflects continued recurrence, not noise sensitivity. The solved-above-wrong ordering also holds in five further settings (a second seed, TRM, Maze, GRAM-guided TRM, N-Queens), but a fixed 1/2 persistence threshold does not, and neither do HRM's endpoint-spectrum and fast-versus-slow predictability patterns, which are not universal diagnostics. Perturb-and-reselect (known from prior work)

translated_title: 当错误答案仍未安定：循环推理器中的失败动力学
translated_abstract: 当一个循环推理器返回错误答案时，它的计算究竟是已经完成，还是仅仅停止了？我们在一个训练好的分层推理模型（HRM；2700万参数，Sudoku-Extreme）上对此进行测试：让递归再多运行一个推理预算，并与未受扰动的对照组进行比较。已解出正确答案的实例大多保持不变（512个终点中0.95的比例保持答案），而错误答案大多不会：接近正确的答案（n=170）中仅有0.42的比例保持原答案，全部512个错误终点中仅有0.18保持原答案。从终端更新尺度的0.05倍到20倍的扰动几乎不改变这些比率，因此该测量反映的是持续的递归计算，而非噪声敏感性。“正确答案比错误答案更持久”这一排序在另外五个设置中也成立（第二个随机种子、TRM、Maze、GRAM引导的TRM、N-Queens），但固定的1/2持久性阈值并不成立，HRM的终点谱和快慢可预测性模式也不成立——它们并非普遍适用的诊断指标。扰动后重选（已知于先前的工作）……
tldr: 该论文发现，循环推理器在多运行一个推理预算后，正确答案大多持续存在而错误答案大多会被修正，这种“正确答案比错误答案更持久”的排序在多个任务中成立，但具体的持久性阈值和可预测性模式并非普遍规律。
en_tdlr: When a recurrent reasoner is given one more inference budget, solved answers largely persist while wrong answers are mostly revised—a "solved-above-wrong" persistence ordering that generalizes across tasks, though fixed persistence thresholds and predictability patterns are not universal diagnostics.
